messages:
anna_dev: quick heads-up — noticed traffic to eu-west gets routed to cheaper us-west fallback even when latency increases ~250ms for interactive flows. happened after the last cost-slope tweak.

mike_arch: ugh, thanks. can you paste an example trace or request attributes? is tenant-level SLA present? :thinking_face:

anna_dev: sure — trace id abc123. tenant: storefront-prod, preferred_region=eu-west, latency_sla_ms=150, cost_tier=standard

jules_sre: is this from the policy-eval change last week? we lowered region penalty weights to curb egress costs.

ryan_prod: yeah that was the intent but we didn't account for latency budget as a hard constraint. current scoring is basically score = base - (cost_weight * cost) - (latency_weight * est_latency). soft prefs meant to be additive.

sarah_ds: proposal: switch to a two-pass evaluator. pass 1: filter by hard constraints (latency_budget, required_region, tenant_tier). pass 2: score remaining candidates with cost/latency mix and region preferences. keeps hard SLAs intact and still optimizes cost.

mike_arch: I like two-pass. alternative is to add a large penalty term when est_latency > latency_sla_ms, but that's brittle and needs careful scaling across sequence lengths.

anna_dev: two-pass sounds safer. also need to define semantics for preferred_region vs region_affinity. prefer_region_soft should be an advisory weight, prefer_region_hard should force region-only.

ryan_prod: agree. draft config sketch:
```yaml
policy:
  match: tenant=*.prod
  hard_constraints:
    max_latency_ms: 150
    required_region: null
  soft_prefs:
    prefer_region: eu-west
    cost_weight: 0.25
    latency_weight: 0.75
```

jules_sre: runtime contract question — evaluator currently returns a single chosen route. to support two-pass we should change it to return an ordered list with reasons so the router can fall back locally without re-invoking policy engine.

mike_arch: yes, return shape: [(route_id, score, reason_tags...)]. reason_tags include tags like "violates_hard_latency" "preferred_region_match" "cost_delta". router can pick first compatible or use hedged call.

sarah_ds: telemetry: add per-decision breakdown in traces: which constraints filtered candidates and which score pushed final choice. will help tune weights rather than guessing.

anna_dev: rollout plan: implement two-pass in sandbox, run for 24h with shadow routing for 10% of traffic, surface alerts if p50 latency regresses >20ms for any tenant. then canary 1% with active routing and 5% with canary checks.

mike_arch: agree. also need migration notes for legacy policies that expect old semantics. default to old single-pass behavior unless policy has "evaluator_v2: true" flag.

ryan_prod: test harness: add unit for mixed candidates where cheap candidate violates latency by small amount — ensure hard_constraints filter it out. adding an automated eval-run across representative prompt set.

deploy-bot: Policy evaluator v2 branch deployed to staging at 2024-11-10T09:23:00Z (build #4728). Run tests with `make policy-eval-test CASE=two_pass`.

jules_sre: I'll own the staging smoke and telemetry dashboards. can someone add the canary runbook snippet for quick rollback? :thumbsup:

anna_dev: adding short rollback to the runbook now. thanks everyone.
